Name: Mohit Gupta
Bio:
Mohit is a Founder of Plaksha University. Mohit is a business leader with a track record in building and scaling category-defining businesses in food delivery and travel e-commerce. He held key leadership roles at Zomato and MakeMyTrip, both of which he helped build from formative stages to IPOs and beyond. He has also invested in and mentored startups, and contributed to significant MandA events in the Indian e-commerce sector. During his decade-long stint with PepsiCo, he handled sales, brand marketing and channel leadership assignments across levels and geographies.

He is now building an omnichannel premium fashion platform at Lyskraft.
